This is a **LAN-only compatibility alpha**. It does not use Epic services or provide Internet
traversal, anti-cheat, account attestation, voice, or an injected overlay. The multiplayer and social
core is live; peripheral EOS families return honest `EOS_NotImplemented` compatibility answers.

Download the package matching the game, not the host OS: Windows games under Proton/Wine still need the
Windows package. Read `QUICKSTART.md`, verify the package against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and use the included
alpha runner for the first test so a sanitized diagnostic bundle is available if the game disagrees
with the emulator.
